reviews.title: Terrific case with huge expansion potential (but it's heavy)
reviews.comment:
I knew Lian Li was popular, but now I know why. I got this case for around $155 and couldn't be happier. The quality is excellent, and the cable management is outstanding! I love the glass panel that shows off the innards of my PC (AMD Phantom Nova motherboard and Ryzen 9070XT graphics card) too.
Now, let me tell you, this is a big case. Do NOT expect it to fit easily in a corner under your desk unless you have a good amount of room (or are going to make space for it). In my case, I redid the furniture to accommodate the case (which tells you how much I loved it). Also, at around 30 pounds empty, this is a heavy case. Install it near the final location you'll have it if you can, it sucks to lug around.
After all that though, I don't think I'll ever get another case again - the expansion potential is huge! And it comes with a graphics card support bracket so you don't need to get a separate one of those (like I did). Love my Lian Li III!
reviews.author: Aj100

reviews.title: Beautiful and elegant
reviews.comment:
The lines on this case are amazing. It looks incredible from every angle. The back panel makes cable management a breeze. There are many places to attach zip ties and an abundance of apertures from the front in which to tuck your cables. You can be as clean as you want front and back. The HDD/SSD brackets are screwed in, making it east to remove them if you won't be utilizing them. The glass side panels and all of the mesh panels slide off thick pins which is super convenient for getting everything out of the way so that you can open the case up. The RGB works great, airflow is amazing, I'd recommend this case to anyone.
The only thing that I dislike about the case is that I had to flip the PSU cover backwards in order to line the holes up with my PSU, so that looks a little funny. I wish they'd send 2 panels to cover either option.
reviews.author: Thomas Pederson

reviews.title: Great case
reviews.comment: The case assembly was a little difficult but I was able to fit my 420mm AIO on top with barely any room to spare and cable management is very easy with this case. I also really like the built in GPU anti-sag bracket. Overall amazing quality case for the price. The case is also fairly heavy, my entire system ended up weighing about 60lbs
